parameters.name: BindType
parameters.description:
The attach type. The default value is user. Valid values:

- user: Attach in a regular user scenario.

- lingo: Attach in a lingo scenario.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description: The Git platform. Valid values: GitHub and GitLab.
